name: Harmony Touch 7.1, the favourite channels and their logos
summary: Each favourite tapped: its channel as digits to the LG TV; and whether each logo shows.
description: On the bench Harmony Touch holding work/touch-firmware/sets/6.9-label-back (the recorded full sync's documents under tags of ours, as put back by the own set and the changed set). Every expectation is derived from those documents by packages/bench/src/touchengine.ts, a model of the engine read in the firmware, and named as the monitor names a code of the Touch's own documents. Step 1 presses Off so no activity runs and the engine holds every device off; what it sends depends on what ran before and is not judged. The favourites belong to Watch TV, tuned through the LG TV, whose channel tuning pads a number to 3 digits and sends nothing before or after it (its start, finish and prefix commands name no command). The favourites screen shows 5, in this order: Zork (channel 666, added by hand, with its own uploaded picture), NPO 1 (channel 1), NPO 2 (channel 2), NPO 3 (channel 3), RTL 4 (channel 4). In step 2, before tapping, write in the step's problem field whether each of the 5 logos shows, and which do not; the monitor cannot see them. Predicted: a favourite tapped with no activity running starts Watch TV first and sends the digits at the end of the start; with it running, only the digits, each digit about 100 ms (the LG TV's InterKeyDelay) after the one before. Two equal digits in a row are separate presses about 250 ms apart in silence; if the monitor shows one press with a repeat instead, read the frames before calling the step failed. Wait for the codes to stop before pressing Next: an activity start runs about 15 seconds, most of it the LG TV's 10 second power on delay.
